explanation: Also known as a torus fracture, this occurs when the bone fails under compressive forces, typical in pediatric patients.
rationale: This type of injury is also frequently called a 'Torus' fracture.

optionExplanations.A: Also known as a torus fracture, this occurs when the bone fails under compressive forces, typical in pediatric patients.
optionExplanations.B: A greenstick fracture involves an intact periosteal hinge on one side with a break on the tension side, rather than a compression bulge.
optionExplanations.C: Plastic deformation refers to the bone bending without a visible cortical break or fracture line.
optionExplanations.D: A spiral fracture is a type of complete fracture usually caused by rotational forces.
